item.tib: gsas mkhar rin po che spyi spungs mdel kha gsang ba'i tan tra las mdos zlog 'khor lo'i cha lags dpa' 'dus dmag gi khrom bskul
item.coloph: mdel zlog gsang ba'i cha lags (lag) / dpa' 'dus dmag gis (gi) khrom bskul zhes bya ba/ stag la me 'bar gyi phyag cha'o/ a/ bkra shis par shog dbra btsun nam mkha' rin chen la snyan du brgyud pa dge legs 'phel lo//
